newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-JETS NAME BELICHICK COACH NEXT SEASON, PARCELLS TO FOLLOW.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-JETS NAME BELICHICK COACH NEXT SEASON, PARCELLS TO FOLLOW.

text.p: The New York Jets announced on Tuesday the hiring of Bill Belichick as head coach for next season to be replaced by former New England Patriots' coach Bill Parcells for the 1998 season.
The Jets said Parcells, who is prohibited from coaching in the National Football League next season unless permission is obtained from the Patriots, had been hired as a consultant.

Belichick, a former head coach of the Cleveland Browns, served as assistant head coach to Parcells last season with the American Football Conference champion Patriots, 35-21 losers to the Green Bay Packers in the Super Bowl.
He had also served as an assistant to Parcells during his Super Bowl victory seasons with the New York Giants.
